description: Changes: adds one group with no rooms held; rooms, rate and cut-off are set in the PMS. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Makes a group (PMS › Group Blocks) with its name, dates and contacts and NO rooms held: rooms, rate and cut-off are set in the PMS. A group with a similar name in the same dates is shown first; confirm_new true makes it anyway. First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to make the change shown in the preview

confirm_new.description: true to make it although a look-alike exists

internal_notes.description: A note for the hotel's staff only; added on top of the group's internal notes

notes.description: Notes for the group's guests (shown on its booking page)

name: create_group
title: Make a group
